questions.content:
The 17^th^ hole at the TPC Sawgrass golf course may be the most famous golf hole in the world due to its island green and the large number of shorts that go in the water. The following table contains the number of strokes various players in the 2011 Players Championship needed to complete the hole. In the table, the frequency row represents the number of players.

  ---------------------------------------------------------
  Number of Strokes($m$)   2    3     4    5    6   7   8
  ------------------------ ---- ----- ---- ---- --- --- ---
  Frequency($f$)           82   278   43   16   6   3   1

  ---------------------------------------------------------

> Calculate

a.  $\sum_{}^{}m$ b. $\sum_{}^{}f$ c. $\sum_{}^{}m^{2}$ d. $\sum_{}^{}{mf}$ e. $\sum_{}^{}{m^{2}f}$ f. $\left( \sum_{}^{}f \right)^{2}$

Back-to-back stem-and-leaf displays can be used to compare the distribution of a variable for two different groups. Consider the following data, which give the alcohol content by volume (%) for different beers produced by the Flying Dog Brewery and the Sierra Nevada Brewery, followed by a back-to-back stem-and leaf display.

> Flying Dog Brewery:
>
4.7 4.8 5.1 5.5 5.5 5.6 6.0 7.1
>
> 7.4 7.8 8.3 8.3 9.2 9.9 10.2 11.5
>
> Sierra Nevada Brewery:
>
> 4.4 5.0 5.0 5.6 5.6 5.8 5.9 5.9 6.7 6.8 6.9
>
> 7.0 9.6
>
> Leaf units at 0.1

  --------------------------------------------

> a\. What would you consider to be a typical alcohol content of beers made by each of the two breweries?

questions.content:
According to the Morningstar.com website, the 2004 total return percentages for several popular funds were as follow:

+------------------------------+------------------------------+
| **Fund**                     | **2004**                     |
|                              |                              |
|                              | **Total Return%**            |
+------------------------------+------------------------------+
| Vanguard 500 Index           | 10.7                         |
+------------------------------+------------------------------+
| Wasatch Core Growth          | 21.7                         |
+------------------------------+------------------------------+
| Fidelity Stock Selector      | 9.9                          |
+------------------------------+------------------------------+
| Fidelity Dividend Growth     | 6.0                          |
+------------------------------+------------------------------+
| Janus Worldwide              | 5.2                          |
+------------------------------+------------------------------+

Suppose that an investor had \$100,000 invested in the Vanguard 500 Index fund, \$500,000 invested in the Wasatch Core Growth fund, \$500,000 invested in the Fidelity Stock Selector fund, \$200,000 invested in the Fidelity Dividend Growth fund, and \$50,000 invested in the Janus Worldwide fund.

a\. Compute a weighted mean that measures the 2004 average total return for the investor's portfolio.

b.  Compare your weighted mean with the unweighted mean of the five total return percentages. Explain why they differ.
